readmeExcerpt:
# Claude Plugins — Community

Community-contributed plugins for [Claude Cowork](https://claude.com/product/cowork) and [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code).

## What this repo is

A **read-only mirror** of the community plugin marketplace. The `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` file here is the list of community plugins available to install. It is synced nightly from Anthropic's internal review pipeline.

Every plugin listed here has been submitted via [claude.ai](https://clau.de/plugin-directory-submission), passed automated security scanning, and been approved for distribution.

## Using this marketplace

### Claude Cowork

Install plugins from [claude.com/plugins](https://claude.com/plugins/).

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-community
claude plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-community
```

## Submitting a plugin

Submit via **[clau.de/plugin-directory-submission](https://clau.de/plugin-directory-submission)**. Pull requests opened directly against this repo are closed automatically — all changes flow from the internal review pipeline.

## Related

- [anthropics/claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official) — Anthropic-maintained plugins
- [anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins) — role-specific knowledge-work plugins

aiSummary.oneLiner: A verified marketplace providing seamless integrations and custom skills for the Claude Code CLI.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository hosts a curated collection of community-contributed plugins and skills for the Claude Code CLI and OpenClaw framework. It acts as a read-only mirror of the internal Anthropic review pipeline, syncing approved marketplace data nightly. By leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP), developers can install specialized tools to connect their local AI agents to external APIs, databases, and file systems. It provides a centralized hub to discover, install, and share custom capabilities that expand the core reasoning engine of Claude Code. All plugins distributed here have passed automated security scanning and official approval.
keyFeatures: Unified marketplace index: Provides a synced list of verified, community-submitted plugins ready for immediate installation.
Automated security scanning: Ensures all distributed plugins have passed strict security checks via the official submission pipeline.
Model Context Protocol integration: Uses standardized MCP communication to seamlessly connect AI agents to external systems.
CLI-driven installation: Allows users to add the community marketplace directly via a single command.
Role-specific extensions: Offers tailored tools designed specifically for distinct workflows like data analysis, coding, or DevOps.
